SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Netball ● Flip pass ● Side pass ● Running pass ● Running shot (, part of Games in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 PHYSICAL EDUCATION FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE.

Key inquiry question: How can practicing skills in Netball help learners develop empathy and teamwork while maintaining a positive team dynamic?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Netball ● Flip pass ● Side pass ● Running pass ● Running shot ( together.

3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Self- efficacy: The learner confidently showcases acquired skills while playing Netball.

• Creativity and imagination: The learner performs the learnt skills and explores new ideas of the game during practise

sessions.

• Critical thinking and problem solving: The learner makes decisions on the skill to execute during a mini Netball Game.

Values:
• Responsibility: The learner actively seeks and responds to feedback on the flip pass, side pass, running pass, and

running shot to improve their skills in Netball.

9

• Unity: The learner participates in groups while playing Netball games.

• Respect: The learner watches videos and discusses Netball skills in passes and running shots while accommodating

others’ opinions.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Healthy lifestyle: The learner’s overall health is enhanced while playing Netball games.

• Social cohesion: The learner interacts with others and embraces equity while playing Netball games.
